description: Generate a STANDALONE dialog with the integration contract open(title, row?, onSuccess?) — after a successful submit it calls onSuccess, where the host refreshes its OWN table (the same contract in both output shapes). mode='composable' (default) emits a reusable useXxxDialog() composable (a .tsx/.jsx module, dialog body is a JSX render — needs the JSX plugin). mode='component' emits a self-contained <es-dialog> SFC instead (no JSX plugin needed; the host must have registered es-plus globally). Use this ONLY when the user explicitly wants a reusable add/edit dialog on its own, or to pair with a separately-generated table / native component. For a full CRUD page use generate_scene (scene='crud') instead (its dialogs are declarative and need no JSX either).

tagType.description: Render this option as a tag in the TABLE cell, in this semantic colour. Ignored by the form controls.

var.description: Model field path to read, e.g. "status" or "user.type"

apiUrl.description: Submit endpoint. If set, the 确定 button POSTs (新增) / PUTs (otherwise); if omitted, it only validates and calls onSuccess(formData).

composableName.description: Exported composable name (default 'useFormDialog'). Ignored when mode='component' (the SFC is a default-exported component).

defaultTitle.description: Default title for open() when the caller passes none. open(title) still overrides it — the first argument remains the single source of truth. Emitted as the parameter default (`title = '新增'`).

fields.description: Form fields shown inside the dialog

apiParams.description: Remote options source for Select/Cascader/TreeSelect — use instead of dataOptions when options come from an API.

attrs.description: Extra component props, e.g. { type: 'textarea', maxlength: 200 }

children.description: Nested-object FORM grouping (ONE level only): this field becomes a full-width section heading; its children render under it. Child `prop` is relative to this field (`city` → `address.city`) unless absolute. The container binds NO data (never a table column) — omit `formtype`; children cannot declare `children` (array sub-forms are OUT of the declarative contract — use `render` or host-owned UI).

apiParams.description: Remote options source for Select/Cascader/TreeSelect — use instead of dataOptions when options come from an API.

attrs.description: Extra component props, e.g. { type: 'textarea', maxlength: 200 }

dataOptions.description: Static options for Select/Radio/Checkbox/Cascader/TreeSelect/Autocomplete. Use this for known fixed enums.

filters.description: Filter options (plain JSON, never a function). On a FIELD they project onto the derived column. Local filtering on the default/vxe engines only — vue3 engine:'virtual' has no filter UI.

text.description: Option text shown in the filter dropdown.

value.description: Row value matched by this option (loose primitive compare: 1 matches "1").

formSpan.description: Grid width of this field in the add/edit form (1-24; 2 columns = 12 each). Column count is set PER FIELD — `formLayout` has no span key.

formatter.description: Extension point: JS arrow-function source for read-only cell formatting, e.g. "(row) => row.amount.toFixed(2)".

formtype.description: Pick by MEANING, not keywords: status/type/enum/gender → Select; date/time → DatePicker/TimePicker; image/avatar/attachment/file → Upload; long text/remark/description → Input (attrs.type:'textarea'); boolean on/off → Switch; single-choice small set → Radio; multi-choice → Checkbox; region/category tree → Cascader; department/org/permission tree with ANY level selectable → TreeSelect; type-to-filter over a known option set → Autocomplete; score → Rate; plain text → Input. OMIT only for a nested-object container (a field carrying `children`) — it renders no input.

group.description: Form-group key for the FORM face. Fields sharing a key are rendered inside that group's container; declare the containers in `formLayout.layout` (query form) or `dialogs[k].formLayout.layout` (dialog form). Ignored by the table column. Omit to follow the layout's `ungrouped` strategy.

field.description: Model field path to test, e.g. "status" or "user.type"

op.description: Operator: eq/ne = equal/not-equal (default eq; number↔string tolerated, e.g. 1 matches '1'); in/nIn = in/not-in the given array; empty/notEmpty = ''/null/undefined/[]; truthy/falsy = JS truthiness. The field is hidden WHEN it holds.

value.description: Right-hand side of the comparison. REQUIRED for eq/ne (scalar) and in/nIn (array). IGNORED by empty/notEmpty/truthy/falsy.

isHidden.description: Hidden when the condition HOLDS — PLAIN JSON DATA, never a JS function string (functions cannot be inlined into a schema-mode pageSchema). `{ field: 'payType', op: 'eq', value: 'cash' }` = hidden while payType is cash; an ARRAY of conditions is AND. TWO forms, never mixed within one node: (1) legacy `{ field, op, value }` with op ∈ eq|ne|in|nIn|empty|notEmpty|truthy|falsy (default eq) — preferred for simple comparisons; (2) a JSONLogic-shaped expression when a plain condition can't express it (OR, ordering, nesting): `{ or: [ { '==': [{ var: 'status' }, 'pending'] }, { '>': [{ var: 'amount' }, 100] } ] }`; expression ops (closed set): var == != > >= < <= in nin empty notEmpty truthy falsy and or not if. A form-(2) op inside a form-(1) node is INVALID (runtime warns and treats the field as visible). Applies to the query/filter and add/edit dialog forms (its `inQuery`/`inForm` placement) — NOT to the table column (`inTable`). Evaluated live by the three renderers.

labelKey.description: i18n key for this field's label (instead of `label`; derived as `field.<prop>` when omitted). Only takes effect once the HOST assembles the plugin with a `t` option (else falls back to `label`).

permissionValue.description: Permission CODE gating this field (RBAC, checked by the host's global permission(code)) — NOT a data-driven condition: use `isHidden` for show/hide by another field's value, `reactions` for options/required/disabled linkage.

prop.description: Field key in the data model (camelCase), e.g. "userName"

querySpan.description: Grid width of this field in the query form (1-24; 2 columns = 12 each). Column count is set PER FIELD — `formLayout` has no span key.

reactions.description: Field-level linkage / computed rules (AI-07) — PLAIN JSON, never JS callbacks. Use when THIS field's options/required/disabled/value depend on ANOTHER field. Each rule `{ dependencies?, when?, fulfill }`: `dependencies` = model paths that re-trigger it (REQUIRED when `fulfill.value` is set); `when` gates the rule; `fulfill` supplies `dataOptions` (literal array), `required`/`disabled` (boolean expressions) and/or `value` (this field's new value, written back). `when`/`required`/`disabled`/`value` are JSONLogic EXPRESSION NODES only (e.g. `{ '==': [{ var: 'country' }, 'us'] }`) — never the `{ field, op, value }` legacy form, never a bare boolean. Example: `city` options follow `province` → one rule per province with `when: { '==': [{ var: 'province' }, 'zj'] }` and `fulfill.dataOptions: [{label:'杭州',value:'hz'}]`. Applies to the query/add/edit forms — NOT the table column. HARD RULE: branching on a dropdown LABEL ('跨境结算') requires that field's `dataOptions` and comparing the VALUE ('cross') — rows carry codes, not labels; `validate_config` warns (non-blocking).

render.description: Extension point: a render-function source string for a custom TABLE CELL, e.g. "(_, { row }) => h(ElTag, { type: row.status === 1 ? A FORM-control render cannot be inlined (form items are serialized as JSON data), so it is preserved as a marked TODO(es-plus) marker in the SFC — NOT silently delivered; prefer the declarative rules/attrs/dataOptions/reactions for FORM behaviour.

rules.description: Validation rules for this field. Use `pattern`/`min`/`max`/`type` for format constraints and `trigger` for when validation runs; `message` is REQUIRED. CONFIG-side (artifact: `formItemOptions.rules`). A rule carrying `type` is dispatched ONLY to that type validator (async-validator `getValidationMethod`) — a `pattern` on the SAME rule is silently ignored, so when the user states BOTH a regex and a type, emit them as TWO separate rules. For a plain text length cap (e.g. '最多 20 字') prefer `attrs.maxlength`; a `min`/`max` rule validates values with a message but does not block typing. Emit these rather than dropping a format/range requirement the user stated.

message.description: Message shown when the rule fails — REQUIRED, write it in the user's language.

min.description: Minimum length for strings / minimum value for numbers.

pattern.description: RegExp SOURCE STRING the value must match (e.g. "^1\d{10}$"), not a RegExp object.

required.description: Enforce a value with this rule (same effect as field-level `required`; prefer the field-level key for unconditional requirements).

trigger.description: 'blur' validates when the field loses focus; 'change' validates while the value changes.

mode.description: Output shape. 'composable' (default) = a useXxxDialog().tsx/.jsx module whose dialog body is a JSX render — requires @vitejs/plugin-vue-jsx (vue3/antdv) or @vue/babel-preset-jsx (vue2). options.description: Declarative dialog base options (core DialogOptions subset). Omitted keys keep the defaults; `title` is NOT an option — it is open()'s first argument (for a fallback value use `defaultTitle`).

appendTo.description: CSS selector of the mount node for the dialog (e.g. 'body' or '#app-dialogs'). A DOM element cannot travel in JSON, so only the selector form is accepted — the runtime resolves it with querySelector and falls back to document.body.

cacheKey.description: Instance cache key: repeat calls with the same key reuse one dialog instance so its internal state survives close/reopen (recycled 10 minutes after close). Implemented identically by all three runtimes (vue3 / vue2 / ant-design-vue).

closeOnClickModal.description: Close when the mask is clicked; default true.

closeOnPressEscape.description: Close when Escape is pressed; default true.

destroyOnClose.description: Destroy the dialog content on close (resets internal state each open).

hiddenFullBtn.description: Hide the built-in fullscreen toggle button.

isDraggable.description: Make the dialog draggable by its header.

maxHeight.description: Max height of the dialog body (scrolls beyond it).

showClose.description: Show the built-in close (X) entry; default true. false hides the self-drawn X and the native one together (the dialog then only closes via footer buttons).

rowkey.description: Primary key used to build the PUT url `${apiUrl}/${formData[rowkey]}` (default 'id')

target.description: Target renderer: vue3 (Element Plus), vue2 (Element UI), antdv (Ant Design Vue)
